title: Paul's ascent to the third heaven

tellings.quote: Some scholars even believe that the Apostle Paul may have been familiar with these practices and he described his own celestial ascent to the third heaven in the second Corinthians

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says some scholars believe the Apostle Paul, an early Christian leader, may have known about ancient practices of rising up through the heavens. Michels points out that Paul describes his own ascent to "the third heaven" in Second Corinthians, one of his letters in the Bible. He raises it as a sign that journeys into other realms run deep in religious history.
